compute_sdf_loss: compute the SDF loss matrix with L1 or L2 loss type given predicted SDF values and bounds
compute_bounds: compute SDF bounds and gradient vectors using ray, normal, or point cloud methods
compute_total_loss: compute the total combined loss including SDF, gradient, and eikonal loss components
compute_tsdf_loss: compute truncated SDF loss with free space and truncation region loss matrices
compute_frame_average_loss: compute frame-averaged loss from total loss matrix using spatial approximation with binary masks
